bases.meaning: A community decision candidate that must move through deliberation and closure states.
A contribution, disbursement, hold, or solvency proof event tied to authorizing evidence.
A conflict or adjudication object requiring claims, evidence, findings, resolution, and closure.
A portable membership/standing credential backed by governance-event evidence.
A wallet/member creation event with consented first-time-participation signal.
A verifiable community record with export/provenance status.

modifiers.semantics: object exists but is not yet evidence-complete
terminal state reached with required closure evidence
object is portable outside the platform
sensitive data, consent, or authority blocker prevents publication/export

transitions.guard: findings != null AND resolution != null AND evidence_refs count >= 1
transitions.product_requirement: Block case closure unless evidence fields are populated.
transitions.acceptance_test: Attempt to close a dispute without findings/resolution/evidence_refs fails.

transitions.guard: purpose length >= 50 AND proposalId != null AND provenance.blockRef != null
transitions.product_requirement: Enforce treasury metadata at service/contract level.
transitions.acceptance_test: Treasury event with short purpose or missing proposalId/blockRef is rejected.

transitions.product_requirement: Emit domain event on ZK solvency proof generation.
transitions.acceptance_test: Verified solvency proof writes a treasury.solvency_proof_generated event with proofHash, verifiedOnChain, balanceThreshold, and txRef.

transitions.guard: domain_event == credential.exported AND evidenceEventCount >= minimum threshold
transitions.product_requirement: Emit credential.exported event on Ichi credential export.
transitions.acceptance_test: Credential export creates event with credentialType, evidenceEventCount, and exportTarget.

transitions.guard: domain_event == member.onboarding_survey_submitted AND firstTimeParticipant is boolean
transitions.product_requirement: Add one-question onboarding survey and event at wallet creation.
transitions.acceptance_test: Wallet creation can submit firstTimeParticipant and writes member.onboarding_survey_submitted.

transitions.product_requirement: Emit case.reopened event with reason and actor authority.
transitions.acceptance_test: Reopened case writes event and links to original closed case.

transitions.guard: demographic data requested without workspace consent / ethics clearance
transitions.current_gap: gender/diaspora fields require governance policy decision
transitions.product_requirement: Route demographic fields through policy/community consent before schema implementation.
transitions.acceptance_test: System blocks demographic collection until policy and workspace consent records exist.

result.finding: The PAGC-derived governance grammar exposes OGI computability gaps as missing state transitions and guards.
result.next_action: Turn GOV-TRANS-001 through GOV-TRANS-005 into product tickets and negative tests in Oroma.
